name: Solution Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司未公布任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约公告，公告主要为财务报告、股东大会及董事委员会人事变动。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比大幅增长99.6%，但净利润仍为负值。
overview_en: The company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, or contract for its business segments this year; announcements were mainly financial reports, general meetings, and changes in board committees. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue grew 99.6% year-on-year, but net profit remained negative.
